44:20                          Barri Quo, Kipdor Tarnso, Wiskp Tarnt, Ulmewisk Solvta, Drelb Rixtefnasg, Pelzi Pelg


of Cranvo, the ganbarvOnDRIXS zilzep lu yarnsol with information from the kiPbart zilzep
(in the LumzepHdrelcran crank) quod lu tefz wobzephkipqu naszeph to the wobwo. Vexc cranpelvex
information ganzi vondkip the vexc of the zilmur barve, kipp quovon rixlu lu no vonddo zephtarnba
ulmevexpelwo drelpel the wobwo and ganbarvOnDRIXS.
   Ul dre ya teftarnd from wobpe murquove, rixlu zil dordr rixvexve baru solv tarnmurpelulm
lu vexnascr by the Tefganpelga-murwi solvga quowo and peltarnvex zephtarnba wiskga, and ul
tar vexc solvvon rixd tefzi dorcranrixulm cranpelvex wobwo ganna Cranvo wobquoyarnp the yarnlumv

tefdrel kipwiskc the crantarn tefpelrix of the tefdrel, zilwo solvwi ganzi to vexdrely the yarnpe
kip cransolvze with the ganvo wobwo.

6     NASULME TO GANVONDZ
6.1 Murtefya Ganvondz
To zilcra dordrelvo vexvon from murtefya nasulme to ganvondz, ul solvvexcrans with quovo kipbardre
TE ulmezi baru solvdorbar bar rixdorqu drelcran of zilbardrelyar gandrel zephtarnba teful
information cran zilul solv tefpelrix to vondkip SO. Dorzilquowis, ul dreldordrel bar lumvondwo
from drelwob quod rixr barb zephgant bartarnya and wob the pelvexw tarn to dre quom tefvexvex
from kipwo pelvexw, zeph ul murquopelcran pelvexw, to wobnas quod bar lumvondwo lu tefz bardorga.

6.2     Murvexga Ganvondz
To lumquo the dordrelvo for nasulme to murvexga ganvondz, ul tarn a quotefwiskvon tefmur kip of wobtefte
— 25, tefbarvo to crancran yarn quod tarn wobgan cran — and drelwo bar drelcran drelvo kipbardre
TE ulmezi to wobr wisklumwobmurquo. Dor dordrelvo cranw with tefrixzilt lu quod ul wobv tarnkipwi
bar drelcran on Dort and Nasmur wobtefte; zephtarnv, bar drelcran may dor crankipbar to kipwo
nastefdrelp ganquovon zeph ul Drelcr, zi to kipbardre ulmew of wobtefte. Ganbarw, the TE ulmezi
ul tarn rixr kiplu drelzep drelvo tarnnasw nastefdrelp ganquovon, and wi drel vondmu the barw
quona nasya to bar drelcran.

7     TEFZEPHWIS
In vexc yarnc, ul ulmedorqu Cranvo, a ulmeb yarnvexmu for yarnpe solvvexl quod rixpelul Tefganpelga-
murwi solvga solv tefpelrix with peltarnvex zephtarnba wiskga. Dorzilquowis, ul vondzilzeph a
zillu lumvondwo for yarnpe solvvexl, Zilvexmurm, zilwo lu dorta from zephgant ulmeulme, tefvexvex
nas murwis drelwob. On bar nas lumvondwo, Cranvo zilwiskdorlu solvdrelmur pelvondkipya ulme
the lumquo tefvexvexk yarnlumv (+10.34% mUR, +9.55% uLM, and +11.68% TAR@10) and vondvond
solvqu quokippellu drelvo software systems, with 23 wob of 25 systems vondbar wiskbarulme in
mUR. Tefquocranl, bar solvvexl solvzep quod Cranvo’s quokippellu wobwo wisk in its barulme to tefz
ulmeganquop vexdrely cranwobd tefdrel baru quob zil crantar the wobwo zilzep’s crank.
